why: Archetype 1 puts Communication Services +32.4 pct absolute, +1.1 pts excess -- modestly ahead of SPY and third among expansion archetypes (The Full Regime-Sector Matrix).

The sector carries direct AI-capex read-through: Alphabet's capex raise is one of the two earnings events the pre-registered episode thesis rests on (wiki/tech.md@a4b6e1f7; Forward Test Pre-Registration, registered 2026-08-23).
risks: Communication Services is the worst excess-return sector in four of the eight archetypes, including every contraction type except credit crisis -- it has the least defensive floor of the eleven if the regime turns (The Full Regime-Sector Matrix).

why: Panel has the sector +2.18 pts vs SPY on the month, in line with the archetype-1 prior (panel metrics, this file).

XLC's history is short -- it did not list until June 2018 -- so its archetype averages rest on fewer episodes than the other nine sectors, and the prior is held with correspondingly less weight (The Full Regime-Sector Matrix).
risks: Ad-cycle sensitivity is the sector's mechanism, and the consumer data in this window is deteriorating (retail sales -0.6 pct, UMich 51.0) (wiki/economic-calendar.md@63b4d3ba; wiki/communication-services.md@8c2ee8eb).
